Play Time
Master Kemal (Auto Repair No:73)
Elif (Neighborhood Council)
Deniz
Return to Hamidiye
Walk to Auto Repair No:73, get your grandfather's sedan keys from Master Kemal, and get inside.
Walk to Auto Repair No:73 and talk to Master Kemal.
Get into the parked sedan outside the garage.
Welcome back, Deniz! Glad you returned to your grandfather's house — the sedan is tuned and fueled.
Here are the keys. Elif just called; a developer called Kaya Holding is sniffing around our old deeds.
Hop in the sedan and bring this parts crate to Elif — she has urgent news for you.
First Errand
Deliver the spare parts crate to Elif before time runs out.
Drive to Elif's drop-off zone before the timer expires.
Step out and talk to Elif.
Right on time, Deniz — thank you. Leave the crate right here.
Wait before you go: a dark courier sedan carrying Hamidiye's historic shop deeds vanished today.
Someone last spotted it parked along Selman Street. Can you look for it on foot?
Trail of the Missing Sedan
Find the abandoned dark sedan on foot and read the note inside.
Head west and locate the missing dark sedan.
Inspect the missing sedan on foot.
Plates match — this is the missing sedan Elif described. The driver door is ajar.
A Kaya Holding memo sits in the glovebox: 'Courier leaves the exit and drops the deed envelope on the west street.'
If I get back to the lookout point now, I can tail that courier and grab the envelope.
Evening Tail
Tail Kaya Holding's courier without getting spotted and recover the sealed deed envelope.
Drive to the lookout point outside the exit.
Tail the courier car at a safe distance (12m – 75m).
Pick up the sealed envelope on foot.
Got the sealed envelope! Inside are Auto Repair No:73's lease and old Selman Street zoning records.
Master Kemal wants them at the garage, while Elif wants them for the neighborhood council. My call.
First Choice
Return to Selman Street and hand the deed envelope to Master Kemal or Elif.
Return to Selman Street.
Deliver the envelope to Master Kemal at No:73 OR to Elif.
I knew Kaya Holding hid these records to squeeze us out! You brought them to the right place.
Nobody can shut down No:73 now. Here is your share (+₺ 300).
The sedan is all yours, Deniz. Go meet the rest of the neighbors!
I knew you'd bring the envelope to the council! The proof of their zoning scheme is right here.
We approved your reward from the community fund (+₺ 300). You gave Selman Street breathing room.
You're truly one of us now, Deniz — our neighbors have a few favors to ask!
Auntie Ayşe
Little Efe
Pharmacist Selin
Mukhtar Remzi
Good day, dear. On Selman Street everybody knows everybody.
Wanna play football? There's a match at the Gürsu Street pitch!
We're the on-duty pharmacy this week. Get well soon!
Our door is always open to every neighbor.
Pick Up Cat
Grocery Order
Bring Auntie Ayşe's groceries from Hüseyin's corner shop.
Talk to Auntie Ayşe on the south sidewalk.
Pick up the grocery bag in front of Selman Market.
Deliver the bag to Auntie Ayşe in time.
My knees are aching, dear, I couldn't walk to the shop.
Hüseyin packed my order, it's by his door. Would you bring it?
Bread, milk, a pack of tea… Auntie Ayşe's order is complete.
Bless you, child! I'll brew some tea for you.
Take this pocket money, don't you refuse it (+300 ₺).
Lost Cat Pamuk
Find Little Efe's white cat Pamuk somewhere in the neighborhood.
Talk to Little Efe, who is crying.
Check the football pitch on Gürsu Street.
Inspect the collar lying on the pitch.
Find Pamuk in the Hz. Osman Mosque courtyard and pick her up.
Bring Pamuk back to Little Efe.
Pamuk is gone! She was following us while we played football…
Can you check the pitch? I'm really scared.
Pamuk's blue collar! There's a fish bone stuck on it…
People feed cats in the mosque courtyard. She must be there.
There she is! Pamuk jumps into your arms, purring.
PAMUK! Thank you, you're a hero!
Mom told me to give you this (+350 ₺).
Pharmacy Rush
Get the medicine for Auntie Ayşe's husband from the pharmacy in time.
Talk to a worried Auntie Ayşe.
Get in your car right away.
Drive to the on-duty pharmacy in the east before time runs out.
Get the medicine from Pharmacist Selin.
Rush the medicine back to Auntie Ayşe.
Uncle Hasan ran out of his blood pressure pills, he's dizzy!
The pharmacy is at the east end of the street. Take your car!
Mr. Hasan's prescription is ready. One a day, after meals.
Hurry, don't be late. Get well wishes!
You made it! Uncle Hasan took his pill, he's feeling better.
You're this neighborhood's angel (+400 ₺).
The Mechanic's Part
Bring Master Kemal's spare part, left at the gas station, back to Auto Repair No:73.
Talk to Master Kemal at Auto Repair No:73.
Drive to the gas station in the west.
Get out and pick up the spare part box.
Drive the part back to the garage before the customer leaves.
Hand the part to Master Kemal.
The courier dropped my part at the gas station, and the customer is waiting!
Take the car, grab the box and come right back. I trust you.
A timing belt kit — the box says 'Auto Repair No:73'.
Right on time! The customer's car will be ready by noon.
Here's your pay (+450 ₺). I also checked your car.
Neighborhood Festival
Help Elif prepare the street festival and tell Mukhtar Remzi.
Talk to Elif in front of No:66.
Pick up the tea box in front of the Tea House.
Pick up the simit tray next to the market.
Go to the festival area (Gürsu St. football pitch).
Tell Mukhtar Remzi the festival is ready.
The festival is tonight and the tea and simit still haven't arrived!
Could you grab the tea from the Tea House and the simit by the market, then bring them to the pitch?
A huge box of Rize tea. The samovars won't run dry tonight.
Warm sesame simits… they smell amazing.
Wonderful! Tea and simit are here, the festival can begin.
All of Selman Street is talking about you. This reward is from everyone (+1000 ₺).
But we aren't done yet, Deniz! Kaya Holding filed a zoning petition at Fatih Boulevard Clock Tower. Lawyer Tarık is waiting for you there!
Lawyer Tarık (Community Advocate)
We're taking every legal step to protect Hamidiye's streets, Deniz.
The Clock Tower File
Drive to Fatih Boulevard Clock Tower Plaza, meet Lawyer Tarık, and inspect the zoning dossier.
Head to Fatih Boulevard Clock Tower Plaza.
Talk to Lawyer Tarık by the Clock Tower.
Inspect the zoning notice file in the plaza.
Bring the file to Lawyer Tarık.
Glad you made it, Deniz! Kaya Holding filed a commercial redevelopment claim covering Selman Street and Zübeyde Hanım.
The notice copy is right beside the Clock Tower. Take a look and bring it back to me.
To block the petition, we need signatures from shopkeepers and parents across Hamidiye's avenues!
Perfect! Collect signatures from Eyyubi, Aziziye, and Petrol Yolu avenues and we'll stop them for good (+550 ₺).
Signatures of Eight Avenues
Visit Eyyubi, Aziziye, and Petrol Yolu avenues to gather Hamidiye's community petition.
Collect the Eyyubi signatures outside 53 Eyyubi Market.
Collect the school parents' signatures at Aziziye St. Primary School.
Collect the merchants' signatures on Petrol Yolu Ave.
Deliver the signed folders to Lawyer Tarık at Fatih Boulevard.
Eyyubi Avenue stands united! Murat gathered signatures from the whole block.
Teacher Merve and the parents signed too — the kids' streets are safe!
Petrol Yolu's merchants signed the last sheet — the folder is packed!
Unbelievable work, Deniz! Hundreds of signatures across eight avenues. I'm filing this first thing (+650 ₺).
One quick favor: Lifeguard Can is throwing a summer pool day for the kids. Could you help him out?
Summer Splash · Pool Day
Pick up the chilled treat crate from Selman Market and deliver it to Hamidiye Swimming Pool!
Pick up the chilled treat crate outside Selman Market No:58.
Head up onto the Hamidiye Swimming Pool deck (south of Selman St.).
Place the crate poolside and enjoy a cool dip!
Return to Lawyer Tarık at Fatih Boulevard for the grand finale.
Ice-cold watermelon, water, and ice cream packed tight! Hüseyin said it's on the house for the kids.
Treats are set poolside! Feel free to jump in for a swim anytime — now let's finish this at the Clock Tower!
The whole neighborhood is smiling, Deniz! Mukhtar Remzi is waiting right here for the final decree (+700 ₺).
Victory for Hamidiye
Collect the sealed Hamidiye Protection Charter and celebrate with Mukhtar Remzi at Clock Tower Plaza!
Pick up the sealed Hamidiye Protection Charter beside the Clock Tower.
Speak with Mukhtar Remzi in the plaza to declare victory.
Official sealed Hamidiye Protection Decree! Kaya Holding's demolition request is permanently rejected!
WE DID IT, DENİZ! Selman Street, Hz. Osman Mosque, our pool, the tennis court, and all of Hamidiye are protected forever!
Your grandfather would be so proud. Accept the community reward (+2000 ₺) and the title 'Hero of Hamidiye'!
Wait, Deniz — Auntie Ayşe just called! She found a clue to a secret 1988 time capsule your grandfather hid in Hamidiye. Meet her on Selman Street!
Mission
Tournament stage won! Next objective updated.
Tap Rematch and win this stage to advance!
Coach Kerem (Sports Complex)
Tennis, Football, Basketball, Volleyball — sports never stop in Hamidiye!
Master Electrician Hasan (Grid Ops)
The Mürşit Ave. transformer is humming cleanly — every street lamp shines bright.
Journalist Defne (Hamidiye Post)
We share every story and truth of our neighborhood with all of Istanbul.
Grandfather's Lost Chest
Solve Auntie Ayşe's three riddles, collect the 1988 brass plaques, and unlock your grandfather's time capsule.
Talk to Auntie Ayşe on Selman Street to hear the first riddle.
Riddle 1: Find the brass cipher plaque in Hz. Osman Mosque courtyard.
Riddle 2: Find the 2nd plaque at Hamidiye Tea Garden & Park.
Riddle 3: Find the 3rd plaque by Zübeyde Hanım's blue pine houses.
Unlock Grandfather's Brass Chest in your garden at No:48!
Bring the 1988 Sports Trophy to Mukhtar Remzi at Clock Tower Plaza.
Deniz dear, I found a 1988 letter from your grandfather! Three brass plaques unlock a hidden time capsule in your garden.
The first riddle reads: 'Gentle fountain water and peaceful stone...' — start at Hz. Osman Mosque courtyard!
Plaque #1 found! Engraved on the back: 'Warm tea aroma, backgammon tiles, and cool park shade...' — Hamidiye Tea Garden!
Plaque #2 secured! Final clue: 'Beneath sky-blue balconies in the pine breeze...' — head to Zübeyde Hanım Ave!
All 3 brass cipher plaques collected! Time to return home to No:48 at golden hour and open the chest.
The chest opens! Inside are a vintage 1988 neighborhood photo, a +900 ₺ heritage fund, and a gleaming brass trophy...
It's engraved 'The Great Hamidiye Sports Cup'! I have to show this to Mukhtar Remzi at Clock Tower Plaza.
Unbelievable, Deniz! That's the legendary 1988 Neighborhood Cup your grandfather founded — we thought it was lost forever (+900 ₺).
Coach Kerem is waiting by the courts — are you ready to compete across every arena and revive the Cup?
The Great Hamidiye Cup
Win matches in Tennis, 3v3 Football, and 2v2 Basketball, take a victory swim at the pool, and claim the trophy!
Talk to Coach Kerem at the Sports Complex to register for the Cup.
Stage 1: Win a Tennis match at Gürsu Court! (Or via Menu → Sports)
Stage 2: Win a 3v3 Street Football match at Hamidiye Pitch!
Stage 3: Win a 2v2 Streetball Basketball match!
Victory cool-down: Dive into Hamidiye Open Swimming Pool and swim!
Return to Coach Kerem to lift the Great Hamidiye Cup.
Welcome, challenger! The whole neighborhood turned out to see your grandfather's 1988 Cup come back to life.
Win a match in Tennis, 3v3 Football, and 2v2 Basketball, then dive into the pool to cool off — the trophy awaits!
CHAMPION PERFORMANCE, DENİZ! Court, pitch, hoops, and pool — you etched your name into Hamidiye history (+1200 ₺)!
Wait — sirens on Mürşit Avenue! Master Electrician Hasan needs emergency help at the power transformer!
Midnight Blackout Rescue
At 22:00, race across Hamidiye to gather high-voltage fuses, generator fuel, and flip the backup relay before power fails.
Speak with Electrician Hasan at the Mürşit Ave. transformer.
Grab the High-Voltage Fuse Box outside Auto Repair No:73 in time.
Collect the Generator Fuel Can on Petrol Yolu Ave. in time.
Flip the Backup Relay Panel along Atatürk Avenue before time runs out.
Rush all gear back to the Mürşit Ave. transformer in time!
Talk to Master Hasan at sunrise to celebrate saving the grid.
Thank goodness you made it, Deniz! It's 22:00 and the main transformer blew — the whole neighborhood is about to go dark!
Grab the fuse box from No:73, generator fuel from Petrol Yolu, flip the Atatürk Ave. relay, and rush back here!
Heavy-duty fuses secured! Now off to Petrol Yolu for emergency generator fuel.
Fuel canister loaded! Next: flip the backup relay switch along Atatürk Avenue.
Relay locked in, line voltage stabilizing! Racing back to Master Hasan on Mürşit Avenue!
We worked all night and not a single home lost power! Sunrise looks sweeter already — thank you, Deniz (+1100 ₺).
Master Kemal called from No:73 — he tuned your sedan for the Eight-Avenue Grand Street Rally!
Eight-Avenue Grand Rally
Push your grandfather's sedan across Fatih Blvd, Eyyubi, Zübeyde Hanım, and Abdülkadir Udeh in a sunset checkpoint circuit!
Meet Master Kemal at Auto Repair No:73 for the rally briefing.
Hop into your sedan and line up for the start.
Gate 1: Blast through Fatih Blvd Clock Tower before time expires!
Gate 2: Swing west and clear the Eyyubi Avenue checkpoint!
Gate 3: Tear south along Zübeyde Hanım Pine Straight!
Gate 4: Round Abdülkadir Udeh & Hz. Osman Mosque corner!
FINISH: Cross the line outside Auto Repair No:73 on Selman Street!
I tuned the engine just for you, Deniz! Today is the legendary Sunset Rally linking all 8 avenues of Hamidiye.
Clock Tower, Eyyubi, Zübeyde Hanım, Abdülkadir Udeh, and home to Selman Street! Ready to floor it?
COURSE RECORD, DENİZ! Your grandfather's sedan flew like the wind — the whole street is cheering (+1400 ₺)!
Hold on... Journalist Defne just sent an urgent tip from Fatih Blvd. Kaya Holding is pulling one last midnight stunt!
Kaya Holding's Final Scheme
At 21:00, follow Journalist Defne's tip, intercept 3 hidden evidence cases across town, and expose the scheme for good!
Meet Journalist Defne on Fatih Blvd for the nighttime tip.
Intercept the hidden document case on Petrol Yolu Commercial Strip.
Recover the encrypted USB & contract file along Atatürk Ave.
Seize the forged zoning envelope outside Aziziye Primary School.
Deliver all evidence to Lawyer Tarık at Clock Tower before time runs out!
Glad you're here, Deniz! Kaya Holding planted forged survey packets across three avenues tonight to undermine our decree.
Grab the cases on Petrol Yolu, Atatürk Ave, and Aziziye School, then rush them to Tarık — I'll prep the front-page broadcast!
First evidence case secured — falsified appraisals! Next stop: Atatürk Avenue pines.
Encrypted USB and secret memos recovered! One last drop outside Aziziye Primary School.
All three dossiers in hand — they even targeted the school block! Racing to Lawyer Tarık at the Clock Tower!
Brilliant work, Deniz! Prosecutors froze their assets immediately and awarded Hamidiye a massive settlement (+1600 ₺)!
Breaking news is live! Tomorrow morning the whole neighborhood gathers at Clock Tower Plaza — it's decision day!
Our World · The Grand Legacy
Win the festival volleyball showmatch, grab the celebration cake, visit Grandfather's plaque, and decide Hamidiye's future!
Speak with Mukhtar Remzi at Clock Tower Plaza.
Festival Showmatch: Win a 2v2 Sand Volleyball match!
Pick up the celebration cake outside Selman Market No:58.
Read Grandfather's Legacy Plaque outside your home at No:48.
FINAL CHOICE: Grant the fund to Lawyer Tarık (Youth Academy) OR Elif (Culture Park)!
Good morning, Deniz! Today we dedicate the community settlement fund — and all of Hamidiye wants YOU to make the final call!
First play the festival volleyball match, pick up the celebration cake, visit your home plaque, and choose our future!
Hüseyin baked a giant cake reading 'Our World · Hamidiye'! Now let me stop by Grandfather's plaque at No:48.
The brass plaque reads: 'It isn't concrete that holds a neighborhood together, it's the hearts of neighbors. — 1988'
Time for the final choice: Lawyer Tarık's Youth Sports Academy, or Elif's Selman Street Cultural House & Pine Park?
Inspiring choice, Deniz! The 'Hamidiye Youth & Sports Academy' opens today — free tennis, football, basketball, and volleyball for every kid!
Across all 20 missions you brought every avenue of Hamidiye to life. Accept the grand award (+3000 ₺) and title 'Legend of Our World'!
This isn't just a neighborhood anymore — it's truly Our World. Play sports, drive, swim, and explore anytime!
What a warm vision, Deniz! The 'Selman Street Culture House & Pine Park' opens today — a timeless gathering home for every neighbor!
Across all 20 missions you brought every avenue of Hamidiye to life. Accept the grand award (+3000 ₺) and title 'Legend of Our World'!
This isn't just a neighborhood anymore — it's truly Our World. Play sports, drive, swim, and explore anytime!

Morning Simit & The 1984 Letter
Simit Vendor Ahmet discovered a faded 1984 neighborhood photo and a mysterious letter.
Talk to Simit Vendor Ahmet at the Town Square cart.
Ask Tea Master Riza at the Tea Garden about the 1984 letter.
Meet Captain Tarik on the Sultanbeyli Lake pier.
Good morning Deniz! While polishing my cart tray this morning, I found a yellowed 1984 photo and a folded letter.
It reads: 'Meet beneath the old plane tree by the lake — Tarik.' Tea Master Riza will surely remember who wrote this!
Take two warm sesame simits over to Riza and let us uncover this neighborhood memory together.
My goodness, Deniz! That young man in the photo is Captain Tarik — back in '84 he was Hamidiye's fastest swimmer and best friend to all.
He still watches the swans every morning from Sultanbeyli Lake pier. Bring him that letter — it will make his year!
I cannot believe my eyes... my letter from forty years ago survived! Thank you, my friend, you brought my youth back.
Look how alive the neighborhood feels again — sports courts, pigeons, tea gardens. Let us organize a Summer Festival for everyone!
Court Rematch: Neighborhood Tennis Cup
Use Topspin, Drop Shots, and Lobs to win the Gursu Tennis Cup.
Talk to Coach Kerem at the Sports Complex.
Play a full 1v1 Tennis match at Gursu Clay Court!
Return to Coach Kerem after the match.
Deniz! Captain Tarik called — we are finally finishing the Hamidiye Tennis Cup rained out back in 1984!
Release your serve in the Golden Zone for a 185 km/h ACE, and mix Topspin with Drop Shots and Lobs to outplay your rival!
What a clinic on clay! The whole crowd cheered your aces and net volleys!
The Hamidiye Tennis Trophy belongs right here in the neighborhood. Bravo, champion!
Sunken Heirloom of Sultanbeyli Lake
